verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's own docs cover all three parts of the story. Tokens are identified by service icons, favorites can be pinned to the top, and tags appear as scrollable tag chips. Search is evidenced by type-to-search on desktop and search deep links. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how tags/groups are created and managed, explicit documentation of search on mobile, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the organization features.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: Easily identify your tokens by their icons
Added type-to-search on desktop for faster code lookup
Added support for search deep links via enteauth://search.
Tag strips that overflow can now be scrolled with the mouse wheel or by dragging, and tag chips are reachable with Tab and selectable with Enter or Space.
